dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Have you come to the ring to work up a sweat, too? Respect!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Pankration...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: It's a very healthy sport!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: If you ask me, you really lose out by being the host! Sure, you get the best seat in the house, but do you think I want to be just watching?

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I want to get in the ring too, and go head-to-head with the best opponents!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Though when I say it like that, it does seem to lack a bit of theatricality, which hand-to-hand combat only has so much of in the first place. I'll have to come up with some other limitations...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Fortress of Meropide...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Heh, it's more my speed than the Fleuve Cendre is.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: It's not that the Fleuve Cendre's bad, I just prefer it here. No matter how you look at it, the Fleuve Cendre just doesn't have any arenas as big as this one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just looking around. See you.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: See ya!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Oho, if it isn't the coach! Here to scope out potential fighters to take under your wing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Pankration...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: It's a very healthy sport!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: If you ask me, you really lose out by being the host! Sure, you get the best seat in the house, but do you think I want to be just watching?

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I want to get in the ring too, and go head-to-head with the best opponents!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Though when I say it like that, it does seem to lack a bit of theatricality, which hand-to-hand combat only has so much of in the first place. I'll have to come up with some other limitations...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: But on the other hand, we've been holding quite a few recreational matches recently. Maybe it's time to get back to the roots? Yeah, it's worth giving some serious thought.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Fonta sponsorship...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I'm not a fan of Fonta, it's too sweet. Pure Water, on the other hand, is pretty decent. Too bad the supply's unreliable.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: That Heinry's a good kid, though. As you know, the majority of people here have hit rock bottom... literally or figuratively, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: If you bring a little sweetness into people's lives at a time like that, they'll never forget it once they turn over a new leaf and get out of this place. Don't you think?
